name: qf_walkie
character: A hand-held two-way radio on the Villain's side of the story: a squelch pop opening each transmission, a clipped band-limited carrier that is voice-like but never words, a roger beep and a squelch tail closing it.
note: No speech is synthesised. The carrier is a pulse train near 140 Hz amplitude-modulated at 5.5 Hz (a syllable rate) with noise, through three formant bands and the telephone band, then driven hard; the squelch tail is the burst of static after a transmission ends; the beep is 1.2 kHz for 90 ms. ESTIMATE: the 300-3400 Hz band is the telephone band (no source gave the radio passband); every level and formant is a starting value
